alt: (decorative: the empty state's title and words say it)
prompt:
Use: a small spot illustration above an empty state's title, shown at most 200 px wide, that shows what will appear in this place once the person adds something.
Subject: a conference day plan: a paper card holding three short session cards stacked in time order down a thin timeline, the middle one marked with a small coral bookmark ribbon.
Details: each session card is a soft rounded rectangle with two blank bars instead of words and a small dot for its room, a tiny round clock at the top of the timeline.
Composition: one isolated object group in the centre, seen slightly from above, filling about 80% of the width, nothing touching the edges.
Style: flat illustration, simple flat colour shapes with soft gouache edges, no outlines, a calm pastel palette (soft indigo, sage, warm sand, one coral accent), gentle light from the upper left with one soft shadow tone on the objects themselves.
Constraints: isolated objects on a fully transparent background; no backdrop, no ground, no cast shadow on the ground, no checkerboard, no frame; no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people.
